colours.name: Knight Blue
alts: Alligator Rider blue alligator-shaped spring rider for kids

data.description: Children sit on the back of a long Knight Blue alligator on this spring rider and rock it on its spring. The alligator's length gives a wide, stable seat, and a child can lean forward or back to make it move. Spring riders are often the first piece a toddler tries on their own, because the movement is gentle and they stay close to the ground. The Alligator Spring Rider fits a water or jungle theme in a society garden, play school or resort kids' area. Our warranty runs 3 years on roto-moulded parts and 1 year on the spring. Send us a photo of your toddler area for suggestions.

items.pText: Children sit on the back of a long Knight Blue alligator on this spring rider and rock it on its spring. The alligator's length gives a wide, stable seat, and a child can lean forward or back to make it move. Spring riders are often the first piece a toddler tries on their own, because the movement is gentle and they stay close to the ground. The Alligator Spring Rider fits a water or jungle theme in a society garden, play school or resort kids' area. Our warranty runs 3 years on roto-moulded parts and 1 year on the spring. Send us a photo of your toddler area for suggestions.

A roto-moulded alligator body is fixed to a steel spring. It can be installed self-standing or by grouting. Keep the area around the alligator's head and tail clear, place it on rubber flooring, and check that the spring has not lost its bounce and that all bolts are tight.
